highlights: The Bench oscilloscope is now a full front panel: glowing traces, volts and time per division knobs with printed scales, AC/GND/DC switches, trigger level, mode and slope, Run/Stop, Single and Autoset.
MEASURE reads Vpp, Vmax, Vavg, Vrms, frequency and the phase and lag between the two channels; CURSOR gives Δt, 1/Δt and ΔV.
The scope behaves like one on a real bench: its probes load the circuit, AC coupling is a real high-pass, and a ×10 probe needs compensating.
The ground clip is tied to earth, so clipping it to a node that isn't ground shorts that node, as it would on a real bench.
The snap is also built for 64-bit ARM Linux.
